taṇhāyati.p: [Taṇhā+āya+ti] (kri) CL=7 It can make attachment as craving, It attaches (on something). It wants to enjoy or use. Fear.
a: တဏှာယတိ(ကြိ)

B:
taṇhāyati： taṇhāyati（kri）
တဏှာယတိ（ကြိ）
[taṇhā+āya+ti]
[တဏှာ+အာယ+တိ]
K:
taṇhāyati：တဏှာယတိ（ကြိ）
[တဏှာ+အာယ+တိ]
တဏှာကဲ့သို့ （တပ်မက်မှုကို） ပြုတတ်၏။ တပ်မက်၏၊ သုံးဆောင်-ခံစား-လို၏။ ကြောက်ရွံ့၏။
R:
taṇhāyati：တဏှာ-ယတိ （နာ）
တပ်မက်မော၏။တဏှာ
DOP: taṇhāyati taṇhīyati , pr. 3 sg. [ denom. from taṇhā], thirsts; has a craving ; S II 13, 32 foll. (ko nu kho bhante taṇhīyatī ti no kallo pañho ti bhagavā avoca … kiṃpaccayā nu kho bhante taṇhā ti esa kallo pañho, Ce, Se so; Be, Ee tasatī ti); Vism 544, 22 (so indriyasampanno phusati vediyati taṇhīyati upādiyati ghaṭīyati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se taṇhiyati); Spk II 78, 21 (n’ eva taṇhāparitassanāya na bhayaparitassanāya paritassati na taṇhāyati na bhāyatī ti attho); Sadd 822, 26 (kattuno upamānabhūtamhā nāmato āyapaccayo hoti ācāratthe: … saddo cicciṭam iva attānaṃ ācārati cicciṭāyati, taṇhāyati).
NCP: pr. 3 sg. | ta.nhaayati (denom. from taṇhā) thirsts, has a craving.
